title: Jolly
body:
Jolly is a 1.8.9 PVP pack made arround the christmas theme and candycanes !


It includes stuff such as custom GUIS, custom skies (with optifine only !), custom block and ressources and much more !


It is mainly made for gamemodes such as Bedwars & Skywars but you can use it in other pvp gamemodes as well as your 1.8.9 survival adventures !


Here are some screenshots to showcase the pack :


![Jolly - #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3907338db558d68793cd83234151614bb2d78663.jpeg)

![Jolly - #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d071aa0198a1b5b7fb585cc9b97d4638467e6a96.jpeg)

![Jolly - #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/790f2c4bfcde82862c7c8edc86c18f516c135ac5.jpeg)


Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Texture pack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Textures not working properly, Sky glitches and/or not rendering...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
